title: PAP Therapy Equipment Self-Pay Price List and Return Terms Sheet
content:
# PAP Therapy Equipment Self-Pay Price List

Any PAP Therapy Equipment device class can be bought outright by a self-pay patient, and the Travel CPAP System (E0601) is sold only that way. For each class the list fixes the cash price of the device sold outright, the delivery and setup fee on a self-pay sale, which is non-refundable, the calendar days after delivery within which a self-pay device may be returned for a refund, and the restocking fee withheld on a self-pay return, as a percentage of the device price.

| Device class | Self-pay retail price (USD) | Delivery and setup fee (USD) | Return window (days after delivery) | Restocking percentage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Travel CPAP System (E0601) | 1149.00 | 19.95 | 30 | 15 |
| CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) | 749.00 | 49.00 | 30 | 15 |
| Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601) | 899.00 | 49.00 | 30 | 15 |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470) | 1850.00 | 49.00 | 30 | 15 |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous-Timed System (E0471) | 4200.00 | 79.00 | 14 | 20 |
| Adaptive Servo-Ventilation System (E0471) | 5600.00 | 79.00 | 14 | 20 |

## Points of reading

- The two classes with a 14-day return window are also the two classes with a 20 percent restocking percentage and a 79.00 delivery and setup fee.
- The return window counts calendar days from the day after the delivery date, the last day of the window included.

**Return window, worked (hypothetical dates).** A CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) delivered on 1 May may come back for a refund through 31 May, the thirtieth day after delivery; 1 June is outside the window. An Adaptive Servo-Ventilation System (E0471) delivered on 1 May may come back through 15 May; 16 May is outside.
